title: packages: POST /packages/:id/adopt-orphans skips requireWritablePackage, so it can bind loose items into a read-only package
body:
## Finding (source reading, not reached through a public door)

`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` on objectstack `main` `9d13b5fc83`: every package write arm checks writability with `requireWritablePackage` before it mutates:
- install / overwrite `:1410`
- disable `:1602`
- publish `:1629`
- revert `:2114`
- edit `:2267`
- delete `:2365`

The adopt-orphans arm (`POST /api/v1/packages/:id/adopt-orphans`, `:2138`) runs `requireManageMetadata` and `refuseWalledCatalogPackageWrite`, then calls `protocol.reassignOrphanedMetadata({ targetPackageId: id })`. It **never calls `requireWritablePackage`**.

So, from the source, it can bind loose metadata items into a **read-only** package: one provided by code or an installed app, which every other write arm refuses with `422 [writable_package_required]` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24705). Whether `reassignOrphanedMetadata` itself refuses a read-only target was not read.

## Wanted

- Read `reassignOrphanedMetadata` for a writability check.
- If there is none, the arm calls `requireWritablePackage(deps, qlService, id, 'adopt items into')` before the protocol call, in the same order as its siblings.
- Pin: adopt-orphans on a read-only package answers 422 and binds nothing; on a writable package it is unchanged.

## Source of the finding

Found by the objectui#13157 dev (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#13181, out-of-scope finding 1). That PR hides "Adopt loose items" on the Packages sheet for a read-only package, so the console no longer offers it. The door itself is this card. Filed by objectui `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`). ⛔ Not a claim; the lane is triage's (`packages/runtime`).

Dedupe words: adopt-orphans read-only package, requireWritablePackage adopt, writable_package_required adopt-orphans.
